title: alibaba/open-code-review
title_zh: 阿里巴巴/开放代码审查

paragraphs.en: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
paragraphs.zh: 安全、快速、高效，并经受了阿里巴巴规模级的实战检验。 混合架构代码审查工具：确定性流水线 + LLM 智能体，提供精准的行级评论，内置多语言规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入），兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。

sents.en: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale.
sents.zh: 安全、快速、高效，并经受了阿里巴巴规模级的实战检验。

sents.en: Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
sents.zh: 混合架构代码审查工具：确定性流水线 + LLM 智能体，提供精准的行级评论，内置多语言规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入），兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。

paragraphs.en: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started.
paragraphs.zh: Open Code Review 是一款由 AI 驱动的代码评审 CLI 工具。 它源自阿里巴巴集团的内部官方 AI 代码评审助手——在过去两年中，它已服务数万名开发者，并识别出数百万个代码缺陷。 经过大规模的充分验证后，我们将其孵化为一个面向社区的开源项目。 只需配置一个模型端点即可开始使用。

sents.en: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool.
sents.zh: Open Code Review 是一款由 AI 驱动的代码评审 CLI 工具。

sents.en: It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects.
sents.zh: 它源自阿里巴巴集团的内部官方 AI 代码评审助手——在过去两年中，它已服务数万名开发者，并识别出数百万个代码缺陷。

sents.en: After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community.
sents.zh: 经过大规模的充分验证后，我们将其孵化为一个面向社区的开源项目。

sents.en: Simply configure a model endpoint to get started.
sents.zh: 只需配置一个模型端点即可开始使用。

paragraphs.en: It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff.
paragraphs.zh: 它读取 Git 差异，通过一个具备工具使用能力的智能体将变更文件发送给可配置的大语言模型（LLM），并生成具有行级精度的结构化评审意见。 该智能体可以读取完整文件内容、搜索代码库、检查其他已变更的文件以获取上下文，从而产出深度评审——而不仅仅是表层的差异反馈。 除差异评审之外，ocr scan 还可以扫描整个文件，用于审计不熟悉的代码库或没有有意义差异的目录。

sents.en: It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision.
sents.zh: 它读取 Git 差异，通过一个具备工具使用能力的智能体将变更文件发送给可配置的大语言模型（LLM），并生成具有行级精度的结构化评审意见。

sents.en: The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback.
sents.zh: 该智能体可以读取完整文件内容、搜索代码库、检查其他已变更的文件以获取上下文，从而产出深度评审——而不仅仅是表层的差异反馈。

sents.en: Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff.
sents.zh: 除差异评审之外，ocr scan 还可以扫描整个文件，用于审计不熟悉的代码库或没有有意义差异的目录。

paragraphs.en: Visit the official website for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 访问官方网站了解更多详情。

paragraphs.en: Compared to general-purpose agents (Claude Code), Open Code Review achieves significantly higher Precision and F1 with the same underlying model, while consuming only ~1/9 of the tokens and completing reviews faster. Note that its Recall is lower than general-purpose agents — a deliberate trade-off favoring precision over noise.
paragraphs.zh: 与通用智能体（Claude Code）相比，Open Code Review 在使用相同底层模型的情况下，取得了显著更高的精确率（Precision）和 F1 分数，同时仅消耗约 1/9 的 token，并更快地完成审查。 需要注意的是，其召回率（Recall）低于通用智能体——这是一种刻意的权衡，宁可牺牲召回率也要减少噪声。

sents.en: Compared to general-purpose agents (Claude Code), Open Code Review achieves significantly higher Precision and F1 with the same underlying model, while consuming only ~1/9 of the tokens and completing reviews faster.
sents.zh: 与通用智能体（Claude Code）相比，Open Code Review 在使用相同底层模型的情况下，取得了显著更高的精确率（Precision）和 F1 分数，同时仅消耗约 1/9 的 token，并更快地完成审查。

sents.en: Note that its Recall is lower than general-purpose agents — a deliberate trade-off favoring precision over noise.
sents.zh: 需要注意的是，其召回率（Recall）低于通用智能体——这是一种刻意的权衡，宁可牺牲召回率也要减少噪声。

paragraphs.en: A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers ( 1,505 annotated ground-truth issues).
paragraphs.zh: 一个基于 50 个热门开源仓库、200 个真实 Pull Request 和 10 种编程语言构建的现实世界代码评审基准——由 80 多名资深工程师进行交叉验证（包含 1,505 条标注的真实问题）。

paragraphs.en: Explore the AACR-Bench dataset on Hugging Face .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Hugging Face 上探索 AACR-Bench 数据集。

paragraphs.zh: 如果你使用过像 Claude Code 这样的通用智能体，并配合 Skills 进行代码审查，你很可能遇到过这些痛点：

paragraphs.en: The root cause: a purely language-driven architecture lacks hard constraints on the review process.
paragraphs.zh: 根本原因：纯语言驱动的架构缺乏对审查流程的硬性约束。

paragraphs.en: Open Code Review's core philosophy is to combine deterministic engineering with an agent, each handling what it does best.
paragraphs.zh: Open Code Review 的核心理念是将确定性工程与智能体相结合，各自发挥所长。

paragraphs.en: Deterministic Engineering — Hard Constraints
paragraphs.zh: 确定性工程 —— 硬约束

paragraphs.en: For review steps that must not go wrong , engineering logic — not the language model — guarantees correctness:
paragraphs.zh: 对于绝不能出错的审查步骤，由工程逻辑——而非语言模型——来保证正确性：

paragraphs.en: The agent's strengths are concentrated where they matter most — dynamic decisions and dynamic context retrieval:
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体的优势正集中在最关键的地方——动态决策与动态上下文检索：

paragraphs.en: npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review After installation, the ocr command is available globally.
paragraphs.zh: npm install -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review 安装完成后，ocr 命令即可全局使用。

paragraphs.en: For other installation methods (install script, GitHub Release binary, from source), see Installation .
paragraphs.zh: 关于其他安装方式（安装脚本、GitHub Release 二进制文件、从源码构建），请参阅 Installation。

paragraphs.en: You must configure an LLM before reviewing code, unless you use Delegation Mode .
paragraphs.zh: 在审查代码之前，你必须先配置一个 LLM，除非你使用委派模式（Delegation Mode）。

paragraphs.en: ocr config provider # Select a built-in provider or add a custom one ocr config model # Pick a model for the active provider
paragraphs.zh: ocr config provider # 选择内置供应商或添加自定义供应商 ocr config model # 为当前活动的供应商选择一个模型

paragraphs.en: The interactive UI guides you through provider selection, API key entry, and model configuration, then automatically tests connectivity.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式 UI 会引导你完成服务商选择、API 密钥输入和模型配置，然后自动测试连通性。

paragraphs.en: For CLI setup, environment variables, custom providers, and other advanced configuration, see Configuration .
paragraphs.zh: 有关 CLI 设置、环境变量、自定义提供商及其他高级配置，请参阅配置（Configuration）。

paragraphs.en: cd your-project # Workspace mode — review all staged, unstaged, and untracked changes ocr review # Branch range — reviews feature-branch's changes since it diverged from main (merge-base mode) ocr review --from main --to feature-branch # Single commit ocr review --commit abc123 # Resume an interrupted range or commit review ocr session list ocr review --from main --to feature-branch --resume < session-id > # Full-file scan — review whole files instead of a diff (no git history needed) ocr scan # scan the entire repository ocr scan --path internal/agent # scan a directory or specific files ocr scan --resume < session-id > # resume an interrupted full-file scan # Save results to a file (recommended for AI host agents) ocr review --format json --output result.json # Delegation mode — let your AI coding agent perform the review itself # OCR handles file selection and rule resolution; no LLM configuration needed ocr delegate preview ocr delegate rule src/main.go src/handler.go Documentation Full documentation lives at open-codereview.ai/docs :
paragraphs.zh:
```bash
cd your-project # 工作区模式 — 审查所有已暂存、未暂存和未跟踪的更改
ocr review # 分支范围 — 审查 feature-branch 自从从 main 分叉以来的更改（merge-base 模式）
ocr review --from main --to feature-branch # 单个提交
ocr review --commit abc123 # 恢复中断的范围或提交审查
ocr session list
ocr review --from main --to feature-branch --resume < session-id >
# 全文件扫描 — 审查整个文件而不是差异（无需 git 历史）
ocr scan # 扫描整个仓库
ocr scan --path internal/agent # 扫描目录或特定文件
ocr scan --resume < session-id > # 恢复中断的全文件扫描
# 将结果保存到文件（推荐用于 AI 宿主智能体）
ocr review --format json --output result.json
# 委托模式 — 让你的 AI 编码智能体自己执行审查
# OCR 负责文件选择和规则解析；无需 LLM 配置
ocr delegate preview
ocr delegate rule src/main.go src/handler.go
```
